description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector' class, which captures and manages error reports generated during HTML purification. It provides functionality to send errors, store structured error data, and generate HTML-formatted error reports.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ErrorCollector
classes.description: A class for collecting and reporting HTML purification errors, providing mechanisms for error addition, retrieval, and formatted display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error collector with a given context, setting locale and error stack.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Records an error with specified severity and message, optionally performing substitutions and associating with the current token or attribute.

methods.name: getRaw
methods.description: Retrieves the raw error data structure containing all collected errors.

methods.name: getHTMLFormatted
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted summary of the collected errors, suitable for display.

methods.name: _renderStruct
methods.description: Internal method for recursively rendering error structures into HTML elements.
